Under legacy semantics, `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, so `_as_model_snapshots` leaves the callback’s snapshot argument unchanged. `solve_model` passes `n.snapshots` rather than the snapshots stored in the model parameters; thus, if `create_model` built the model over only a subset of the network snapshots, the callback receives the full network index instead of that subset.
